title: Fields you may not change are dimmed, with the reason in their tooltip
steps: With -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar open Calendar (2) and click an afternoon meeting with Sam Rivera (someone else organizes it)
Look at each row: title, time, repeat and visibility are disabled; reminders, Busy or Free and colour still work
Try to type in any field, then hold the pointer over a dimmed row
expected: Rows you cannot change are dimmed and do nothing; no amber or lock sentence shows anywhere in the card. Holding the pointer over a dimmed row shows why (for example that someone else organizes the event); VoiceOver reads the same. Decline replaces the trash.
